name: Roane State Community College
tuition_note: In-state (resident) tuition & fees 2026-27 ($4,992 tuition + $356 fees = $5,348/yr, based on 15 credit hours) from roanestate.edu Tuition and Fee Listing page (/?9185-Tuition-and-Fee-Listing).
